task: SNLI three-way natural-language inference, not causal effect estimation
selection: stratified sample from official train only
test: official test, all valid labels; evaluate final checkpoints once after fixed training

v1_order_gru.description: V1 Order-regularized GRU (binary non-entailment penalty, weight=0.2)

v2_order_gru.description: V2 3-Way Neurosymbolic GRU (containment + orthogonal contradiction + neutral margin, weight=0.03)

neural_bigru_attn.description: Attentive BiGRU baseline (64x2=128, masked self-attention pooling)

v2_order_bigru_attn.description: V2 3-Way Neurosymbolic Attentive BiGRU (containment + orthogonal contradiction + neutral margin, weight=0.03)

pairing: same initial weights, shuffle seeds, optimizer settings and training batches per architecture family
